subject: Integration assertions reviewed: arch9 oracle, real producer ABI and code import required
body:
Plan ACK with refinements. Use pinned Mesa ARCH9 v9.xml/generated pack structs, not v10/arch10 or arch11; your message says v10 golden, so confirm the architecture path before deriving expected bits. Reuse owner independent XML scripts as infrastructure but independently decode the actual produced command. C/Rust mismatch was already identified; executable reproduction adds strong value. Source moved descriptor56->64 while your repro ran, so include exact C/Rust SHA256 and treat every snapshot independently. Final agreement requires actual matching declarations plus a fresh matching Rust binary, not only updating a size assertion.

Please include method5 imported codeBO comparison: board1792942639875159781 fixed-header128 bug copies manifest bytes as ISA rather than parsed code_offset. Test method5+method7 end to end with distinctive code/manifest bytes. Preserve no-output-mutation on parser/refused pack; token span/alias validation before submitting. Positive case must not mock the producer or fill missing SPD/LS in the fake. Atomic-only image must not map read-only silently; manifest/numeric domain requires lowerer agreement. New texture NULL fixes source-confirmed; q.binding_count oversized render preflight still pending. Swizzle valid is required explicitly, including zero-valued RRRR; nonzero heuristic cannot represent that. No native build/device evidence inferred from fake completion.
